replacements.Latencia, coste y diseño para modelos ra: Latency, cost and design for reasoning models
replacements.Cuando el test-time compute se convierte: When test-time compute becomes real seconds of waiting, the paper's trade-offs become product decisions.
replacements.El usuario siente respuesta directa. Sin: The user feels a direct response. No additional waiting-state design is needed.
replacements.Pausa perceptible pero el usuario no pie: The pause is noticeable, but the user does not lose their train of thought.
replacements.Spinner o progreso necesario. A los 5-7: A spinner or progress state is necessary. At 5–7 s the user starts to disengage.
replacements.Los modelos razonadores operan aquí. Sin: Reasoning models operate here. Without explicit design, the default experience is poor.
replacements.Distribución real de latencia · LLM + he: Real latency distribution · LLM + tools + RAG
replacements.Una consulta de complejidad media en un: A medium-complexity request in a real agentic system: ~20 s total
replacements.Implicación: la mejora de latencia puede: Implication: latency can be improved both in the model (less TTC) and in the system architecture (RAG caching, faster tools).
replacements.En modelos con pensamiento extendido (Cl: In models with extended thinking (Claude 3.7 Sonnet), reasoning tokens are billed at the same price as output tokens.
replacements.Una cadena de razonamiento larga tiene c: A long reasoning chain has a cost proportional to the number of internal tokens generated even when the user never sees them.
replacements.Con modelos razonadores el coste no es p: With reasoning models, cost is not predictable from request type alone. A simple question and a complex one can have radically different cost profiles.
replacements.Consulta compleja · 500 tokens de pensam: Complex request · 500 reasoning tokens = 3× higher cost
replacements.Sin presupuestos por consulta, las factu: Without per-request budgets, API bills are unpredictable at scale.
